pages.text: Per-level reduction by worn slot:$(br)Slot: general / extra breath$(br)Head: 1.25% / 5%$(br)Chest: 2.5% / 15%$(br)Legs: 2.5% / 10%$(br)Feet: 1.25% / 5%.

Add general reductions (cap 50%). Void and ordinary magic are excluded; breath still qualifies. For dragon breath, add the extra breath reductions (cap 70%) and apply to the remainder. At both caps, 100 breath damage becomes 15.
Shields gain 25% block amount and 10% block angle per level and can block dragon breath while raised. They do not grant passive armor-slot reductions.
At four combined active levels on worn armor and held shields, non-boss mobs within 10 blocks with at most 20 current health try to flee. They need functioning AI and a usable escape path.
